description.ja: 『閃光のハサウェイ』より、反地球連邦政府組織マフティーの主力ＭＳメッサーＦ０２型をＨＧシリーズで商品化！
description.en: From "Flash of Light Hathaway", the main MS Messer F02 type of the anti-Earth Federation government organization Mufti is commercialized in the HG series!

description.ja: 「リフティング・フレア」を追加した脚部など劇中に登場するＦ０２型の造形を新規パーツを交え再現。指揮官機を再現可能な頭部パーツが付属。
description.en: The model F02 that appears in the movie, such as the legs with "lifting flares", is recreated with new parts. A head part that can reproduce the commander aircraft is included.

description.ja: ●　メッサーＦ０２型を徹底再現！
description.en: ● Thorough reproduction of Messer F02 type!

description.ja: 「リフティング・フレア」を追加したＦ０２型の脚部形状を新規パーツを交え精密に再現。開いた状態の左手パーツに加え、
description.en: The leg shape of the F02 model with the added "lifting flare" is precisely reproduced with new parts. In addition to the left hand part in the open state,

description.ja: 指揮官機を再現可能な頭部パーツが新規造形で付属。
description.en: A new head part that can reproduce the commander aircraft is included.

description.ja: ●　可動ギミックにより多彩なアクションポーズが可能。

description.ja: 劇中のホバー走行状態も再現可能。
description.en: The hover running state in the play can also be reproduced.
